simple.meaning: דָּלַח (dâlach) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to roil water.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

definitions.full: H1804. dalach [ דָּלַח ] verb make turbid (Assyrian dalâ—u , disturb , Zim Bp 81 also in derivatives; Palestinian דְּלַח ᵑ7 figurative be anxious, fear , turbavit, conturbavit ) — Qal Imperfect 2masculine singular, וַתִּדְלַח Ezek 32:2-3 ;feminine singular suffix תִּדְלָחֵם 32:13 + 32:13 (Co תרפשׂם ); — stir up, trouble, make turbid (always with feet ) followed by מים 32:2 (|| תִּרְמֹּס , — ס Baer, and not שׂ ); so 32:13 a, b (but 32:13 b. Co reads תרפשׂ (compare 32:2 ) for תדלחם ).
